system.prerequisites: Inner Discipline, Devoted or Illuminator Monastic Path
system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

Prerequisites Inner Discipline, Devoted or Illuminator Monastic Path

You adopt the coiled readiness of the serpent, focusing on reactive precision. While in this stance, you may use a reaction to make a melee strike against a target that misses you in with their own melee strike. Your attack ignores MAP.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it, when a creature misses you with a melee Strike you are asked whether to use your reaction for a melee Strike against it, at no multiple attack penalty. The reaction counts as an Attack reaction, so Battle Readiness's may take it (Graham's B6-9). The Path is checked when you enter it.
